mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate below 0.5% (as of t-1mo) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns. The mechanism is active whenever the rate is low, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (measured at t-1mo).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% (as of t-1mo) signals economic weakness, prompting market anticipation of monetary stimulus and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in year-over-year CPIAUCSL above 3.0% and stable or falling FEDFUNDS (change < 0% over 3 months) signals stagflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS change < 0% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS change < 0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (current PAYEMS level above 139,000 thousand) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 139,000 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 900,000 units (as of t-2mo) signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%) signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong retail sales environment (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450.0.
